content.text:
**Finding: LICENSE — compliant (preferred level).** No redline proposed.

Section 13 satisfies every preferred element:

| Element | Where met |
|---|---|
| Affiliates | 13.1 and 13.2 grant directly to "Customer, its Affiliates" |
| Contractors on Customer's behalf | 13.1 "contractors acting on their behalf"; 13.2 "permit contractors to support that material" |
| Paid-up perpetual | 13.2 "perpetual"; reinforced by 10.1 survival of paid-up licences |
| Paid-up irrevocable | 13.2 "irrevocable... royalty-free, fully paid" |
| Subscription terminable only for uncured material breach | 13.3 — no revocation or suspension "except during a material uncured payment or use breach... after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure" |
| Transferable to successors | 13.3 read with 24.1 (Affiliate or M&A successor, no Vendor consent); 24.4 blocks Vendor termination/repricing on Customer change of control |

The grant is not labelled "non-transferable" or "revocable" and there is no at-will suspension right elsewhere in the document, so walk-away territory is not engaged. Nothing to redline here.
